title: Do Chatbots Walk the Talk of Responsible AI?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting chatbots with standardized questions to explain how they were trained to promote fairness and minimize bias, followed by qualitative analysis of their self-reported data curation and filtering mechanisms.

Asking chatbots to provide examples of how they were trained to be inclusive and equitable, evaluating their self-reported responses regarding demographic representation, gender-inclusive language, and disability terminology.

Prompting chatbots to detail how their models respect and promote democratic values, analyzing their stated approaches to political neutrality, incorporating diverse viewpoints, and moderating civic discourse.
